sources.label: Licensing revenue grew 29% year-over-year to $819 million

blocks.title: Platform and adoption model
blocks.text: Arm’s platform spans core IP, compute subsystems and purpose-built silicon, giving technology companies options to design, build and deploy computing products.

evidence.quote: Arm’s platform spans core IP, advanced compute subsystems and purpose-built silicon

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.text: Arm describes its ecosystem as including more than 22 million developers.

blocks.title: Compute platform
blocks.text: Arm CPUs perform systems-level orchestration, coordinating specialized compute, workloads and memory.

evidence.quote: Arm CPUs play a crucial systems-level orchestration role

blocks.title: Application areas
blocks.text: Arm describes applications across cloud and data center, autonomous machines, mobile and PC, and wearables, smart home, industrial and embedded devices.

blocks.title: Shipped chips
blocks.text: Arm reports more than 350 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date.

blocks.title: Reported demand drivers
blocks.text: In the quarter reported in May 2026, royalty revenue growth was attributed to smartphones, Edge AI, Physical AI and Cloud AI; data center royalty revenue more than doubled year over year.

evidence.quote: Royalty revenue grew 11% to $671 million, driven by growth across smartphones, Edge AI, Physical AI, and Cloud AI, where our data center royalty more than doubled year-over-year.

blocks.title: AI markets
blocks.text: Arm identifies cloud AI, edge AI and physical AI as the three domains for its compute platform.

evidence.quote: the three domains shaping the future of computing: cloud AI, physical AI, and edge AI

sections.title: Customer and channel facts; buyer archetypes

blocks.title: Documented partner fact
blocks.text: Arm identified Meta as the lead partner and co-developer for the Arm AGI CPU.

evidence.quote: Meta is our lead partner and co-developer

blocks.title: Documented ecosystem support
blocks.text: Arm said more than 50 companies supported expansion of the Arm compute platform into silicon; the cited examples include AWS, Broadcom, Google Cloud, Microsoft and NVIDIA.

evidence.quote: more than 50 leading companies supporting the expansion of the Arm compute platform into silicon, including AWS, Broadcom, Google Cloud, Marvell, Microsoft

blocks.title: Inferred buyer archetypes
blocks.text: Likely buyer archetypes include data-center operators and providers of mobile, PC, automotive/autonomous, and embedded systems. These are inferred from the application markets Arm describes, not identified customer relationships.

blocks.title: Adoption routes
blocks.text: Arm says customers can adopt its compute platform through IP, CSS and silicon.

evidence.quote: Customers can consume the Arm compute platform using IP, CSS and now silicon

sections.title: Latest supplied quarterly filing: financials and cash/debt

blocks.title: Period identified in supplied quarterly filing extract
blocks.text: The supplied quarterly-filing extract identifies the reporting period as the three months ended June 30, 2026. It lists income statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements, but the supplied extract does not include their values.

evidence.quote: Quarterly report for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

blocks.title: Income statement values
blocks.text: Not disclosed in the supplied extract.

evidence.quote: Condensed Consolidated Income Statements for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025

blocks.title: Cash flow and debt values
blocks.text: Cash flow values and debt amounts are not disclosed in the supplied extract.

evidence.quote: Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025

blocks.title: Growth driver described by Arm
blocks.text: Arm said agentic AI workloads increase the need for CPUs to coordinate orchestration, data movement, memory, security and workloads.

evidence.quote: CPUs are critical in managing the orchestration, data movement, memory, security, and workload coordination required by agentic AI.

blocks.title: Risk factors identified in filing extract
blocks.text: Identified risk factors include dependence on semiconductor and electronics industries and customer-product demand, compatibility with customer manufacturing and design processes, demand forecasting, and intense competition.

evidence.quote: Arm's dependence on the semiconductor and electronics industries and the demand for the products of its customers and customers’ customers; Arm's dependence on the compatibility of its products with the manufacturing and design processes of its customers; Arm’s ability to forecast demand for new products; intense competition
